name: add_comm
result.signature: {G : Type u_1} [AddCommMagma G] (a b : G) : a + b = b + a
result.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMagma G] (a b : G), a + b = b + a
result.informal_description: For any two elements $a$ and $b$ in a commutative additive magma $G$, the sum $a + b$ equals $b + a$.

add_comm

name: add_comm_sub
result.signature: {α : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup α] (a b c : α) : a - b + c = c - b + a
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup α] (a b c : α), a - b + c = c - b + a
result.informal_name: Rearrangement of a subtraction and an addition
result.informal_description: For elements $a, b, c$ of an additive commutative group, $a - b + c = c - b + a$.
